description_en: Performs a paging query on the running instances of an agent and supports filtering by sandbox ID and current valid session ID fragments
description_zh: 分页查询智能体的运行实例，支持按 Sandbox ID 和当前有效 Session ID 片段筛选
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore list-sandboxes --workspace-id ws-1 --agent-id agent-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSandboxes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the managed Harness agent
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: If this parameter is omitted or left blank, the latest running unit of the agent is queried. If this parameter is specified, the service endpoint must belong to the agent and the target type must be AGENT_VERSION. Otherwise, Resource.NotFound is returned. An independently running service endpoint returns only the sandboxes of its own running unit. If the DEFAULT service endpoint has not taken over independent running, the query falls back to the latest running unit. If a non-DEFAULT service endpoint is not running independently, ServiceEndpointTargetNotReady is returned. If the running unit is not created, an empty list is returned and totalCount is 0, without reporting an error
parameters.help_zh: 省略或传空白时查询智能体 latest 运行单元；传入时该服务端点必须属于本智能体且目标类型为 AGENT_VERSION，否则返回 Resource.NotFound。独立运行的服务端点只返回其自身运行单元的 Sandbox；DEFAULT 服务端点尚未接管独立运行时回落到 latest 运行单元；非 DEFAULT 且未独立运行时返回 ServiceEndpointTargetNotReady。运行单元尚未创建时返回空列表且 totalCount 为 0，不报错
parameters.name: service_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: Performs a case-insensitive fuzzy search by sandbox ID fragment
parameters.help_zh: 按 Sandbox ID 片段模糊搜索，不区分大小写
parameters.name: search_text

parameters.help_en: Performs a case-insensitive fuzzy search by current valid session ID fragment
parameters.help_zh: 按当前有效 Session ID 片段模糊搜索，不区分大小写
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单页最大返回条数，默认 20，取值为 1～100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The cursor for querying the next page. When you turn the page, you must keep workspaceId, agentId, searchText, sessionId, and maxResults unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 查询下一页的游标；翻页时须保持 workspaceId、agentId、searchText、sessionId 和 maxResults 不变
parameters.name: next_token

code.description_en: The business status code. The value is SUCCESS if the request is successful
code.description_zh: 业务状态码，成功时为 SUCCESS

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value is 200 if the request is successful

items.description_en: The list of sandboxes that meet the filter conditions
items.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的 Sandbox 列表

activeSessionCount.description_en: The number of active sessions in the sandbox
activeSessionCount.description_zh: 该 Sandbox 当前的活动 Session 数量

createdAt.description_en: The time when the sandbox was created. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format
createdAt.description_zh: Sandbox 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

harnessVersion.description_en: The tag of the actual observed image of the currently returned instance. This parameter is empty if the tag cannot be parsed
harnessVersion.description_zh: 当前返回实例实际观测镜像的 tag；无法解析时为空
harnessVersion.title_en: 实例实际镜像对应的 Harness 版本
harnessVersion.title_zh: 实例实际镜像对应的 Harness 版本

lastActiveAt.description_en: The time of the last activity of the sandbox. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format
lastActiveAt.description_zh: Sandbox 最近一次活动时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

lastHeartbeatAt.description_en: The time of the last heartbeat of the sandbox. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format
lastHeartbeatAt.description_zh: Sandbox 最近一次心跳时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

lastRebuildOperationId.description_en: Used to continue calling GetSandboxRebuildOperation to query the overall result after the page is refreshed. This parameter is empty if there is no historical rebuild. Do not use the ID of a subsequently created task instead
lastRebuildOperationId.description_zh: 用于页面刷新后继续调用 GetSandboxRebuildOperation 查询整体结果。没有历史重建时为空；不要改用后续创建任务 ID
lastRebuildOperationId.title_en: 最近一次 Sandbox 重建的首次任务 ID
lastRebuildOperationId.title_zh: 最近一次 Sandbox 重建的首次任务 ID

maxConcurrentSessions.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent sessions allowed for the sandbox, which is obtained from the effective auto-scaling configuration at runtime. This parameter is empty if auto-scaling is disabled or the configuration is unavailable
maxConcurrentSessions.description_zh: 该 Sandbox 允许的最大并发 Session 数，取自运行时生效的自动扩缩容配置；自动扩缩容未启用或配置不可用时为空

phase.description_en: The current running phase of the sandbox

sandboxId.description_en: The sandbox ID. You can query it by calling ListSandboxes
sandboxId.description_zh: Sandbox ID，可通过 ListSandboxes 查询

updateAvailable.description_en: The server compares the actual image tag of the instance with the target image tag of the pool. The value is true if the tags are different during the RUNNING, HIBERNATED, or FAILED phase. The value is false if the tags are the same or during other known phases. This parameter is empty if the tag or phase cannot be confirmed, and it cannot be treated as false. The version sequence is not determined by the tag size
updateAvailable.description_zh: 服务端比较实例实际镜像 tag 与 Pool 目标镜像 tag。RUNNING、HIBERNATED、FAILED 阶段 tag 不同时为 true；tag 相同或其他已知阶段为 false。tag 或阶段无法确认时为空，不能按 false 处理；不按 tag 大小判断版本先后
updateAvailable.title_en: 实例是否未对齐 Pool 目标镜像 tag
updateAvailable.title_zh: 实例是否未对齐 Pool 目标镜像 tag

updateFailed.description_en: A value of true indicates that the most recent rebuild corresponding to the current instance generation failed as a whole. A value of false indicates that there is no historical rebuild or the rebuild succeeded as a whole. This parameter is empty if the rebuild is in progress, canceled, replaced, the generation does not match, or the result cannot be confirmed
updateFailed.description_zh: true 表示当前实例代次对应的最近重建整体失败；false 表示无历史重建或整体成功；进行中、已取消、被替代、代次不匹配或结果无法确认时为空
updateFailed.title_en: 最近一次重建是否失败
updateFailed.title_zh: 最近一次重建是否失败

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records per page for this query
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询的单页最大记录数

message.description_en: The response message. The value is success if the request is successful
message.description_zh: 响应消息，成功时为 success

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. An empty value indicates that no more results are available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页的分页令牌；为空表示没有更多结果

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败

totalCount.description_en: The total number of records that meet the query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 符合本次查询条件的记录总数
